title: In search of experienced time: how the heart-brain coupling supports time perception
summary: Combining a novel experimental paradigm with cutting-edge neuroimaging, this Leverhulme fellowship project aims to establish that time awareness arises from an intricate brain–body interplay.

title: Perceived time expands and contracts within each heartbeat
summary: Do you ever feel like time slows down when you're bored but flies when you're having fun? Let's explore the ways your brain and heart shape your perception of time, revealing how your heartbeat doesn't just keep you alive: it also influences whether moments feel fleeting or stretched.

title: Seeing through each other's hearts: inferring others' heart rate as a function of own heart rate perception and perceived social intelligence
